name: squat-progress
about: A progress question is answered from the exercise history, quoting the real top sets from the start and end of the block.
question: How has my back squat moved over the last month?

script.text: Your top working set has climbed every week: 100 kg on {today-21}, then 102.5 kg, 105 kg, and 107.5 kg on {today-2}. The reps held at every step, so keep adding load.
